start_frame.description: 仰角全景，从轮椅底部开始，展现轮廓剪影

end_frame.description: 仰角中近景，沈清起的面容在阴影中显现

movement.description: 仰角拍摄，从轮椅底部缓缓上移，配合轻微推近，展现沈清起的压迫感

ai_video_prompt.movement_description: Low angle shot starting from the base of an old wooden wheelchair, slowly tilting upward to reveal a pale young man with a cold, menacing expression sitting in the wheelchair. Silhouette against cold blue-grey lighting.
ai_video_prompt.camera_motion_en: Slow tilt up with subtle dolly in, low angle emphasizing power, arc path, ease-in-out, 6 seconds
ai_video_prompt.technical_specs: 35mm to 50mm zoom, low angle composition, cold blue-grey color grading, silhouette lighting

emotion_mapping.camera_rationale: 仰角拍摄配合缓慢上移，强调沈清起的压迫感和神秘感
